description: This is a Python source file implementing a client for uploading data to S3, managing Kuksa data sources, and creating parquet files for data storage. It includes classes for S3 interaction, Kuksa client handling, and parquet file management, along with a main function to run the data collection loop.

classes.name: ServerType
classes.description: Enumeration for server types: kuksa_val_server and kuksa_databroker.

classes.name: S3Client
classes.description: Client for interacting with Amazon S3, including bucket creation and file upload.

classes.name: KuksaClientError
classes.description: Custom exception class for Kuksa client errors, with methods to create instances from VISS or gRPC errors.

classes.name: KuksaClient
classes.description: Factory class to instantiate specific Kuksa client based on configuration.

classes.name: KuksaVALServerClient
classes.description: Client for Kuksa VAL server, retrieves data types and values via KuksaClientThread.

classes.name: KuksaDatabrokerClient
classes.description: Client for Kuksa Data Broker, retrieves data types and current values via gRPC.

classes.name: ParquetPacker
classes.description: Manages creation of parquet files from Kuksa data, uploads to S3, and handles periodic data collection.

methods.name: from_config
methods.description: Creates a KuksaClient instance based on configuration, choosing between VAL server and Data Broker.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes respective classes with configuration parameters.

methods.name: get_datatypes
methods.description: Retrieves data types for specified paths from Kuksa source.

methods.name: get_values
methods.description: Retrieves current values for specified paths from Kuksa source.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the Kuksa client connection.

methods.name: create_new_parquet
methods.description: Creates a new parquet file with timestamped filename.

methods.name: gen_schema
methods.description: Generates a schema for parquet file based on data types of paths.

methods.name: write_table
methods.description: Writes data to parquet file, manages file rotation based on max rows.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Main loop to periodically fetch data and write to parquet.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the parquet packer, including closing files and cleaning up.
